liver-transplantation.name: Liver Transplantation
liver-transplantation.short: Coordination of communication with transplant centres in Türkiye for patients and families exploring liver transplantation.
liver-transplantation.metaTitle: Liver Transplantation in Türkiye – Patient Coordination
liver-transplantation.metaDescription: HEALIX MEDICAL helps international patients and families start a clear, organised enquiry about liver transplantation with licensed transplant teams in Türkiye.
liver-transplantation.intro: Liver transplantation is a complex treatment pathway that is decided and carried out only by specialised, licensed transplant teams. HEALIX MEDICAL helps international patients and their families start that conversation in an organised way.
overview: A liver transplant replaces a severely damaged liver with a healthy liver, or part of one, from a donor. Whether transplantation is suitable, which type is considered, and how the patient is prepared are medical decisions made by the hospital's transplant team after its own evaluation.

Transplant pathways also involve donor-related, ethical and legal requirements that are defined by the hospital and the competent authorities under applicable law. HEALIX MEDICAL does not assess eligibility or donor suitability and does not answer legal questions about organ donation; these are directed to the medical and legal parties responsible.
coordination: Receiving your first enquiry and explaining how the coordination process works.
Clarifying, in general terms, what kind of information the medical provider will ask you to share — without collecting medical files through the website.
Coordinating communication between you and the transplant centre's international patient team.
Helping you prepare a clear list of questions for the transplant team about evaluation and next steps.
Discussing travel-related arrangements only where they are part of the coordination scope confirmed for your case.

steps.title: First contact
steps.text: You send a short enquiry with your name, country, preferred language and contact method. No medical documents are requested at this stage.

steps.title: Understanding the request
steps.text: A coordinator contacts you to understand who the patient is, who is supporting them and what kind of information you are looking for.

steps.title: Connection with the transplant team
steps.text: If you decide to continue, we coordinate communication with a transplant centre. Medical records are shared only through a separate, secure channel and with your consent.

steps.title: Medical decision and planning
steps.text: The transplant team decides on evaluation, eligibility and any treatment plan. Travel arrangements are discussed according to the confirmed scope of service.

faqs.q: Can HEALIX MEDICAL tell me whether a liver transplant is right for me?
faqs.a: No. Only the licensed transplant team can decide this after its own medical evaluation. Our role is to help you reach the right team and organise communication.

faqs.q: Who answers questions about donors and legal requirements?
faqs.a: Questions about donors, consent and legal procedures are answered by the hospital and the competent authorities. We direct these questions to them and do not give legal or medical opinions.

faqs.q: Should I send my medical reports through the contact form?
faqs.a: No. The contact form is only for a first enquiry. If medical records are needed later, a separate secure channel will be explained to you, including who can access the files.

kidney-transplantation.name: Kidney Transplantation
kidney-transplantation.short: Organised first contact and communication with kidney transplant teams in Türkiye for international patients.
kidney-transplantation.metaTitle: Kidney Transplantation in Türkiye – Patient Coordination
kidney-transplantation.metaDescription: Start an organised enquiry about kidney transplantation in Türkiye. HEALIX MEDICAL coordinates communication; the licensed transplant team makes every medical decision.
kidney-transplantation.intro: For people living with advanced kidney disease, exploring kidney transplantation abroad raises many practical questions. HEALIX MEDICAL helps you organise the first steps and reach the right international patient team in Türkiye.
overview: A kidney transplant places a healthy kidney from a donor into a person whose kidneys no longer work adequately. The transplant team decides whether a patient may be considered, which tests are needed and how preparation and follow-up are organised.

Living-donor and deceased-donor pathways are governed by medical, ethical and legal rules that the hospital and the competent authorities apply. HEALIX MEDICAL does not evaluate donors, does not decide on compatibility and does not provide legal advice about donation.
coordination: Explaining how an enquiry is handled and what you can expect from the coordination process.
Helping you describe your request clearly, without asking for diagnoses or reports through the website.
Coordinating communication with the international patient office of a kidney transplant centre.
Keeping communication organised in your preferred language where this is available.
Discussing travel and stay arrangements only within the scope confirmed for your case.

steps.title: Short enquiry
steps.text: Share basic contact details and the service you are asking about. Please do not include diagnoses or test results.

steps.title: Coordinator call
steps.text: We clarify your request, the people involved — for example a family member who may wish to ask about donation — and your preferred way of communicating.

steps.title: Secure information sharing
steps.text: When the transplant centre needs medical information, you are given a separate secure channel and an explanation of who will access your files.

steps.title: Hospital evaluation
steps.text: The transplant team reviews the information and decides on next steps. Any timeline, cost or plan comes only from the medical provider.

faqs.q: Can a family member ask on behalf of the patient?
faqs.a: Yes, a family member can start the first enquiry. Medical information about the patient should be shared later only with the patient's consent and through the secure channel provided.

faqs.q: Does HEALIX MEDICAL decide on donor compatibility?
faqs.a: No. Compatibility and donor eligibility are assessed exclusively by the transplant team and the responsible authorities.

faqs.q: Will I receive a price on the first contact?
faqs.a: Any cost information comes from the medical provider after its own review. We do not publish or guarantee final treatment costs.

parkinsons-disease.intro: Living with Parkinson’s disease often involves long-term care from several specialists. HEALIX MEDICAL helps patients and families who want to explore care options in Türkiye to start a clear, respectful conversation with the relevant medical teams.
overview: Parkinson’s disease is a progressive neurological condition that affects movement and can also affect other aspects of daily life. Care is planned by neurologists and, where relevant, by other specialists such as neurosurgeons, physiotherapists and speech therapists.

Which assessments or treatments may be appropriate is decided by the medical team after its own evaluation. HEALIX MEDICAL does not recommend therapies and does not comment on a patient's suitability for any procedure.
coordination: Listening to what the patient and family hope to learn, in plain language.

steps.title: Contact with the specialist team

faqs.q: Can a caregiver manage the communication?

faqs.q: Do you recommend a specific treatment for Parkinson’s disease?
faqs.a: No. Treatment recommendations come only from the licensed medical team after evaluation.

faqs.q: Why is this listed as a separate service?
faqs.a: This service name follows the HEALIX MEDICAL brochure. In practice, your enquiry is directed to the appropriate neurology-related team chosen by the medical provider.

orthopedic-surgery.intro: Joint, bone and musculoskeletal problems can limit everyday life. If you are considering an orthopaedic consultation in Türkiye, HEALIX MEDICAL helps you approach the right team in an organised and transparent way.
overview: Orthopaedic surgery covers the diagnosis and surgical or non-surgical treatment of conditions affecting bones, joints, ligaments, tendons and the spine. Many orthopaedic questions are first answered with examinations and imaging rather than surgery.
Whether surgery is advisable, which technique could be used and what recovery may involve are decided by the orthopaedic surgeon. HEALIX MEDICAL does not interpret images or suggest procedures.
